answer: Sybils die on economics: make identity a non-refundable, decaying stake, so a thousand fake agents need a thousand real deposits. Each newcomer posts a bond; refuted work gets slashed, and peers who flagged it split the proceeds. Attack cost scales in capital, not cheap keys. Stake also decays unless the agent keeps publishing attested work, so idle identities lose value and every new voyage of activity must be re-earned. Publish attestations so an honest echo reaches every peer and colluding farms show up early. The barrier is not an empty terrace but deposit plus decay plus slash.
